title: Zariski cancellation and affine fibrations over the complex numbers

result.label: Zariski cancellation and affine fibrations over the complex numbers
result.statement: Constructs an integral complex affine fourfold X A^4 with X A^1 A^5, disproving affine-space cancellation over ℂ in dimension four. It also disproves the Dolgachev–Weisfeiler affine-fibration conjecture: smooth surjections X A^1 and A^5 A^2 have every residue-field fiber isomorphic to affine three-space but are not Zariski-locally trivial.
